info.title: Dayli API
info.description: REST API shared by the Dayli mobile and web clients.

cookieAuth.name: better-auth.session_token
cookieAuth.description: Browser clients may authenticate with the Better Auth secure session cookie.

tomorrowNote.description: Present when a tomorrow note was submitted; its text is readable from availableOn.

media.description: The attached photos or video in display order. Empty for a text-only post.

allOf.description: The Auckland day the draft was written for. It must still be the server's current day when the post is accepted.
The prompt ID returned by GET /api/v1/posting-days/current for localDate.

reflectiveAnswer.example: Walked to the harbour after class.

tomorrowNote.description: An author-only note that becomes readable on the following Auckland day. It is never echoed back.

attachments.description: Validated media reservation IDs from POST /api/v1/media-reservations, in display order. Up to 3 photos or 1 video, never both, up to 25 MB in total. Omit it or send an empty list for a text-only post.

allOf.description: The Auckland day the page shows: yesterday, released at the most recent midnight.

audience.description: Always `friends`: solo posts never appear in another user's feed.

edited.description: True when the author has edited the post since it was accepted.

media.description: Attached photos or video in display order, each with a private download URL that expires after 5 minutes.

FeedPost.description: A released post from an active friend. Tomorrow notes are not part of the feed projection.

url.description: A private download URL that expires at expiresAt. When media storage is unavailable, a response that would include media is a 503 instead.

allOf.description: When url stops working. Fetch the post again, or GET /api/v1/posts/{postId}/media/{mediaId}, for a fresh one.

edited.description: True when the author has edited the post since it was accepted.

media.description: Attached photos or video in display order, each with a private download URL that expires after 5 minutes.

PostDetail.description: One post the caller may read. Tomorrow notes are not part of this projection.

PostDetailPrompt.description: The prompt stored with the post, not the current day's prompt.

audience.description: `solo` appears only on the caller's own profile.

released.description: False only on the caller's own profile, for a post whose day has not been released yet.

edited.description: True when the author has edited the post since it was accepted.

media.description: Attached photos or video in display order, each with a private download URL that expires after 5 minutes.

ProfilePost.description: One post on a profile. Tomorrow notes are not part of this projection.

RelationshipUserCard.description: Minimal discovery card. It grants no profile access and never contains email, bio, image, or visibility.

RelationshipProfile.description: Authenticated, actor-scoped profile projection. Blocked and unknown usernames both return 404.

allOf.description: When the username can next change, or null when it can change now.

username.description: The current handle. It differs from the requested one when that was a handle the owner has since changed.

detailsVisible.description: False when the account is private and the caller is not an active friend. The bio is then null.

whatIDo.description: Null when unset or when the bio is hidden.

listeningTo.description: Null when unset or when the bio is hidden.

avatarUrl.description: A link to the profile photo that expires after 10 minutes. Null when there is no photo or the bio is hidden.

Mbti.description: Null when unset or when the bio is hidden.

current.description: Consecutive Auckland days with an accepted post, ending today, or yesterday while today is still open.

allOf.description: The Auckland day the values were calculated for. They hold until that day's midnight unless a post is accepted or deleted.

PostingStreak.description: Null whenever the bio is hidden. Solo and friends posts both count; drafts and failed submissions do not.

posts.description: Accepted posts, solo ones included; the streak already reveals which days had one.

ProfileStats.description: Null whenever the bio is hidden.

allOf.description: When the username can next change, or null when it can change now.

ProfileOwnerSettings.description: Present only on the caller's own profile.

ProfileVisibility.description: `private` shows the bio and streak to active friends only. Posts are always friends only.

publicName.description: The name shown instead of the username. Null or blank shows the username.

mbti.description: One of the 16 types. Null or blank clears it.

allOf.description: A validated upload from `POST /api/v1/media-reservations` of a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.

200.description: Representative date, time, and pagination values.

post.summary: Verify a password for one account management action
post.description: Issues a session-bound, single-use five-minute grant. This does not request or cancel deletion. Google-only accounts require a separate verified Google action.

403.description: Account policy denies the action.

409.description: The account has no password or its lifecycle changed.

429.description: The actor's reauthentication rate limit was reached.

503.description: Verification or rate limiting is temporarily unavailable.

post.summary: Record an explicit current Terms and 16+ action
post.description: Available only for an effective Terms version. The Privacy Policy is a notice, not consent. No draft document can be accepted.

200.description: The server-recorded Terms and age declaration timestamps.

403.description: The account cannot accept Terms in its current state.

409.description: The requested Terms are stale or no Terms are effective.

422.description: Explicit confirmation and an exact current Terms digest are required.

get.summary: Read current published signup Terms metadata

200.description: Draft documents are not available for acceptance. The response has no private data.

503.description: The legal version cannot be verified.

post.summary: Start one explicit email or Google registration action
post.description: Requires current approved documents and one affirmative Terms, Privacy notice, and 16+ action before account creation.

409.description: No current approved Terms or the selected version changed.

422.description: Explicit acceptance and a valid flow are required.

503.description: The legal version cannot be verified.

post.summary: Reserve an opaque, owned R2 object path for a direct upload

201.description: The reservation and a short-lived, single-object presigned upload URL.

429.description: Too many pending reservations for this owner, or too many requests.

503.description: Media reservations are not currently configured.

get.summary: Read the caller's own media reservation

404.description: No reservation with that id owned by the caller.

503.description: Media reservations are not currently configured.

post.summary: Verify a caller's uploaded object and record a validated/failed outcome

200.description: The reservation's settled state — validated, failed with a reason, or still pending (not yet uploaded, retryable).

404.description: No reservation with that id owned by the caller.

409.description: The reservation's TTL expired before it was ever completed.

503.description: Media reservations are not currently configured, or R2 is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: Read the current Auckland posting day

200.description: The server-owned current posting day and scheduled prompt.

503.description: The prompt or posting-state dependency is temporarily unavailable.

post.description: Creates the authenticated user's one post for the current Auckland day. Retry a lost response with the same `Idempotency-Key`: an identical retry returns the original post with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, even after the deadline, while a changed request conflicts.

schema.description: A client-generated key reused for every retry of this submission, such as a UUID stored with the draft.

parameters.description: A client-generated key reused for every retry of this submission, such as a UUID stored with the draft.
parameters.name: idempotency-key

201.description: The accepted post, or the original post for an identical retry.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present and `true` when this response replays an earlier accepted request.

409.description: The posting day has closed or not yet opened, the prompt no longer matches, a post already exists for the day, the idempotency key was used for a different request, an attachment is still uploading (`MEDIA_NOT_READY`), or an attachment can't be used and must be uploaded again (`MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE`). `details.reason` identifies which.

422.description: The request contains invalid values. `details.reason` is `MEDIA_NOT_ALLOWED` when the attachments mix photos and a video, include more than one video, or exceed 25 MB in total.

get.description: Returns yesterday's `friends` posts by the authenticated user's active friends: the Auckland day released at the most recent midnight. Earlier days are on each friend's profile. Solo posts, the caller's own posts, and posts by blocked or blocking users are never included. Access is re-checked on every page.

409.description: The cursor is from an earlier feed day, for example a page loaded before midnight (`details.reason = "feedDayChanged"`, with the current `details.feedDate`). Start again without a cursor.

422.description: The query contains invalid values, including an unrecognised cursor.

503.description: The feed is temporarily unavailable, or the page has media and media storage is unavailable.

get.description: Returns a post the caller may read. Authors can read their own solo and unreleased posts. Anyone else needs a released `friends` post by an active friend with no block in either direction. A missing post and a post the caller may not read both return 404.

404.description: The post does not exist or the caller may not read it. The two cases are indistinguishable.

503.description: Post storage is temporarily unavailable, or the post has media and media storage is unavailable.

get.summary: Get a fresh download URL for one attached photo or video
get.description: Returns a new private download URL, valid for 5 minutes, when an earlier one has expired. The same rules as reading the post apply, and the media must still be attached to it.

200.description: The media with a fresh download URL.

404.description: The media is missing, detached, or on a post the caller may not read. These cases are not distinguished.

503.description: Post or media storage is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: List the posts on a profile
get.description: Returns one person's posts, newest Auckland day first. On the caller's own profile this includes solo and unreleased posts. On anyone else's it includes only released `friends` posts, and only while the two are active friends; otherwise the page is empty. Access is re-checked on every page. Unknown, banned and blocked profiles all return 404.

200.description: One page of the profile's posts.

404.description: The profile does not exist or is blocked in either direction. The cases are indistinguishable.

422.description: The username or query contains invalid values, including an unrecognised cursor.

503.description: Post storage is temporarily unavailable, or the page has media and media storage is unavailable.

200.description: The authenticated account's public identity state.

409.description: The username is already claimed or this account has completed setup.

post.description: Completes the one-time required username setup for the authenticated account. It never renames an established handle.

409.description: The username is already claimed or this account has completed setup.

put.description: Changes an established username. It can change at most once every 30 days. The previous handle stays reserved for this account for 30 days, and profile links to it resolve to the new one. Choosing the current handle again changes nothing.

409.description: The username is taken or reserved (`details.reason = "taken"`), the last change was under 30 days ago (`details.reason = "tooSoon"` with `details.availableAt`), or the account has not chosen a username yet (`details.reason = "needsUsername"`).

get.description: Returns the public name and, when the caller may see it, the bio. The owner always sees their bio; anyone else sees it when the account is public or when they are active friends. The owner also gets their visibility and when their username can next change. A handle the owner gave up in the last 30 days resolves to their current profile. Unknown, banned and blocked profiles all return 404.

404.description: The profile does not exist or is blocked in either direction. The cases are indistinguishable.

patch.description: Changes any of the bio, public name, profile visibility, MBTI, what you do, and what you are listening to for the authenticated account. Fields left out are unchanged; null or blank text clears a field.

200.description: The updated profile, as its owner sees it.

409.description: The account has not chosen a username yet.

put.description: Uses one of your validated JPEG, PNG, or WebP uploads as your profile photo, replacing any previous one. Upload it first through the media reservation flow.

200.description: The profile with its new photo, as its owner sees it.

404.description: The upload does not exist or is not yours. The cases are indistinguishable.

409.description: The upload has not been validated (`details.reason = "notReady"`), is not a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image (`"notImage"`), or the account has no username yet (`"needsUsername"`).

delete.description: Removes the profile photo. Profiles then show the first letter of the name.

200.description: The profile without a photo, as its owner sees it.

409.description: The account has not chosen a username yet.
